svg.aria-label: Bars: a 150 ms budget allows servers 14,000 km away, 50 ms 4,000 km, 20 ms 1,000 km, 5 ms only 200 km
svg.text: if the round trip must be under…, the server can be at most this far away (light in fibre: 200 km per ms)
150 ms: a video call feels natural
50 ms: an online game feels fair
20 ms: a virtual-reality headset doesn’t make you queasy
5 ms: a factory robot arm stays in step
after allowing up to 10 ms for the radio, the queues and the server’s own work. Real cables wander, so real distances are shorter.

figure.figcaption: The latency budget. Past a certain point, speed isn’t the problem: distance is. The only way to answer in 5 ms is to be nearby: at the edge.
